[LGRA.2.10.4] `::` (COLONCOLON) is the postfix conversion cast ([LGRA.9.6],
[LCST.4.1]); `?` (NULLABLE) marks a nullable type in a type position
([LGRA.2.5.3], [LNUL]); `.` (DOT) is both slot access and the separator between
a library path and a member it exports (`units.si.meter`, `lib.CONST`). Which it is
in a given name is decided by scope ([LGRA.22.9]), never by the grammar. `;` is not
a DS token ([LLEX.16.5]).
